description: This file contains unit tests for the DrugValidator class within the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic for Drug objects, including null checks, reference map validation, field length constraints, and duplicate mappings.

classes.name: DrugValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the DrugValidator's validation logic within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: executeDrugMappingsDataSet
methods.description: Sets up test data for drug mappings before each test case.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheDrugObjectIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the Drug object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfDrugOnDrugReferenceMapIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when a DrugReferenceMap within the Drug object has a null Drug reference.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptReferenceTermOnDrugReferenceMapIsNull
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when the conceptReferenceTerm in DrugReferenceMap is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldInvokeConceptReferenceTermValidatorIfTermOnDrugReferenceMapIsNew
methods.description: Verifies that the validator correctly validates new ConceptReferenceTerms.

methods.name: validate_shouldInvokeConceptMapTypeValidatorIfConceptMapTypeOnDrugReferenceMapIsNew
methods.description: Ensures validation occurs for new ConceptMapType objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectDrugMultipleMappingsToTheSameTerm
methods.description: Checks that duplicate mappings to the same concept term are rejected.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Confirms validation passes with correct and complete Drug data.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Confirms validation passes when field lengths are within constraints.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that overly long field values are rejected by validation.
